svg.title: 02 Melody review and correction - Second Voice UI mockup
svg.desc: Illustrative desktop interface for a songwriter's harmony sketchpad. This is a design mockup, not a transcription service.
svg.text: Make sure we heard you right.
Review the detected melody before adding harmony.

svg.text: Solo a part to hear its line.
Fix a few notes here, or record
again if the take feels off.
Drag a note up or down.
Move notes along the beat grid.
Shift the take to find beat one.
A few wrong notes? Edit. A whole take off? Re-record.
Example take / 8 bars / single voice / timing edits are reversible
Listen with the backing chords to confirm the timing.
Desktop UI concept. All notes and takes shown are illustrative.
